column1: # Expected census of the frozen extractor corpus -- the extractor pin.
# This is what scripts/citation_audit.py must say about guide.tex, notes.md and
# tracked.txt, which never change when a live document is edited. A diff here is
# therefore a change in the *extractor* (a resolution rule relaxed, a variant
# tokenised differently, a class re-attributed) and has to be justified as one.
# Deliberately hand-maintained: there is no flag that regenerates it, because a
# one-command refresh is how an extractor pin turns into a rubber stamp. Free-text
# comment lines are not compared; #tracked, #census and the rows are.
